**Backend-leaning full-stack engineer building platform services and AI tooling**

I work across the stack, from domain services and data pipelines to React frontends and AI-native projects.

### 🔭 Right now

- **Active stack:** Java 25 and Spring Boot services on PostgreSQL, Cucumber BDD suites and Testcontainers, shipped to Azure and Kubernetes with OpenTelemetry.
- **AI tooling:** MCP servers and LLM-powered agents with Spring AI and the Claude and OpenAI APIs.
- **Side projects** (stealth projects, in active development):
  - **AlgoTradeX:** an algorithmic trading platform. Java 25, Spring Boot 4, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Docker.
  - **CricAI:** a cricket management game with watchable 3D matches. TypeScript, React, Vite, Babylon.js.
